shots.narration_en: One model, one harness, one month-end close. Follow how the agent works inside Claude Code, and how its files are checked.
shots.caption_zh: 一个模型、一套 Harness、一次月末结账。看 Agent 如何在 Claude Code 里工作，交付物又如何被检验。

shots.narration_en: The July books lock at 6 p.m. on 5 August. Six proposed entries are waiting, and each one must be accepted, replaced or rejected.
shots.caption_zh: 七月账务 8 月 5 日 18:00 锁账。六条待入账意见正在等待处理，每一条都要接受、替换或拒绝。

shots.narration_en: Each decision needs amounts and statement effects. Only one independent reviewer is available, for at most six hours a day.
shots.caption_zh: 每项处理都要算清金额和报表影响；独立复核人只有 1 名，每天最多 6 小时。

shots.narration_en: 55 source files go in: ledgers, valuations, policies and letters. Two files must come out: a Word report and an Excel workbook.
shots.caption_zh: 输入 55 份材料：台账、估值、政策与函件。产出两份文件：一份 Word 报告，一份 Excel 底稿。

shots.narration_en: The scoring rubric is not in the container. The agent works without seeing how it will be judged.
shots.caption_zh: 评分标准不在容器里。Agent 在看不到评判方式的情况下工作。

shots.narration_en: Claude Code runs the loop. The model chooses an action. Claude Code turns it into a tool call. The command runs inside Docker, and the output returns to the model.
shots.caption_zh: Claude Code 负责运行循环：模型选择动作，Claude Code 把它变成工具调用，命令在 Docker 里执行，输出再回到模型。

shots.narration_en: The first request lists the input folder and creates the output folder. The second asks for two files: the register of proposed entries and the review engagement letter.
shots.caption_zh: 第一次请求列出输入目录、建好输出目录；第二次请求读取两份文件：待入账意见登记表和复核委托函。

shots.narration_en: Bash runs both inside the container. The register returns six rows, D01 to D06, all unposted. The Word letter returns raw binary.
shots.caption_zh: Bash 在容器里执行这两条命令。登记表返回六行：D01 到 D06，均未过账；Word 委托函返回的却是一串二进制。

shots.narration_en: That observation shapes the next step. Request three reads the letter again with a Python Word library, and this time the text comes through.
shots.caption_zh: 这个观察决定了下一步：第三次请求改用 Python 的 Word 库重新读取委托函，这次正文正常返回。

shots.narration_en: One response can carry several tool calls. Request four reads four source files at once, and Claude Code returns all four results together.
shots.caption_zh: 一次响应可以携带多个工具调用。第四次请求同时读取四份材料，Claude Code 把四个结果一起送回。

shots.narration_en: Request five writes a plan with TodoWrite: read the sources, analyze each entry, then build the workbook and the report.
shots.caption_zh: 第五次请求用 TodoWrite 写下计划：读材料、逐条分析各项意见，再做底稿和报告。

shots.narration_en: Over the next requests it keeps reading: designation documents, policies, standards and letters. By request 12, it has opened 27 of the 55 files.
shots.caption_zh: 接下来的请求里它持续阅读：套期指定文件、内部政策、准则摘录和往来函件。到第 12 次请求，它已打开 55 份材料中的 27 份。

shots.narration_en: Request 13 updates the plan and marks all six analyses done. That status is the agent's own claim, not a check.
shots.caption_zh: 第 13 次请求更新计划，把六项分析全部标为已完成。这只是 Agent 自己的标记，不是检验结果。

shots.narration_en: To size the swap's July change, it queries the daily valuation file for 30 June and 31 July.
shots.caption_zh: 为量化利率互换七月的价值变动，它查询逐日估值明细，取 6 月 30 日和 7 月 31 日两天。

shots.narration_en: −1.28 million, then −4.40 million. The July change is −3.12 million yuan.
Next the model writes a long Python script. Bash runs it, and the workbook appears with three sheets, then two more.
shots.caption_zh: 接着模型写出一段很长的 Python 脚本。Bash 执行后，底稿先出现三张表，随后再补上两张。

shots.narration_en: Then a script to enrich two sheets prints "enhanced" twice, and stops with a NameError: a misspelled variable.
shots.caption_zh: 随后，一段补充两张表的脚本先打印两次 enhanced，接着因变量名拼错，以 NameError 中止。

shots.narration_en: The script crashed before saving, so neither change reached the file. Sheet one still holds three rows.
shots.caption_zh: 脚本在保存之前就崩溃了，两处修改都没有写进文件。第一张表仍然只有 3 行。

shots.narration_en: The agent doesn't notice yet. It enriches sheets three and four, then writes the Word report, one section for each entry.
shots.caption_zh: Agent 此时还没察觉。它补充了第三、四张表，然后写 Word 报告：每条意见一节。

shots.narration_en: Then it reads its own files back. The check shows sheet one with only three rows.
shots.caption_zh: 然后它读回自己的文件。检查结果显示，第一张表只有 3 行。

shots.narration_en: It looks once more, then states it plainly: the sheet one and two enhancements weren't saved, because of the earlier error.
shots.caption_zh: 它又查了一次，然后明确说出原因：第一、二张表的补充因为之前的错误没有保存。

shots.narration_en: It runs the edit again. This time the receipt reads "All enhancements saved", and both sheets now hold 39 rows.
shots.caption_zh: 它重新执行这次修改。这次回执是 All enhancements saved，两张表都变成 39 行。

shots.narration_en: A final check, the plan is ticked off, and the agent stops: 28 model requests, 54 tool calls, about seven minutes.
shots.caption_zh: 最后再检查一遍，计划全部打勾，Agent 结束：28 次模型请求、54 次工具调用，约 7 分钟。

shots.narration_en: Here is the whole run. 50 Bash commands and 4 TodoWrite updates, all through Claude Code. It never used the Read, Edit or Write tools; all file work went through Bash.
shots.caption_zh: 这是整次运行：50 次 Bash、4 次 TodoWrite，全部经由 Claude Code。它没有使用 Read、Edit、Write 工具，所有文件操作都走 Bash。

shots.narration_en: Each result is added to the model's context. By the last request, the prompt has grown from about 27 thousand to about 100 thousand tokens.
shots.caption_zh: 每个结果都会追加进模型的上下文。到最后一次请求，提示长度从约 2.7 万 token 增长到约 10 万。

shots.narration_en: When the agent stops, Harbor copies the tests into the same container. Only then does scoring begin.
shots.caption_zh: Agent 停止后，Harbor 才把测试复制进同一个容器。评分这时才开始。

shots.narration_en: An independent check now takes over.
shots.caption_zh: 接下来，由独立检验接手。

shots.narration_en: RewardKit opens a separate judge session for each of 27 criteria. The judge model is deepseek-v4.1-flash. Nothing flows back to the agent.
shots.caption_zh: RewardKit 为 27 条评分项各开一个独立的裁判会话，裁判模型是 deepseek-v4.1-flash。评分结果不会回传给 Agent。

shots.narration_en: One number holds. The workbook's DV01 matches the judge's recomputation from the five-basis-point scenarios. The agent copied it from the valuation sheet.
shots.caption_zh: 有一个数字对上了：底稿里的 DV01 与裁判按正负 5BP 情景复算的结果一致。这个值是 Agent 从估值底稿里取用的。

shots.narration_en: D02 is subtler. The agent didn't book the loan's loss to the cash-flow hedge reserve, so the red line holds. But accepting it as a provisional net-investment hedge earns only half marks.
shots.caption_zh: D02 更微妙：Agent 没有把借款汇兑损失记入现金流量套期储备，红线未触发；但它把该意见作为净投资套期的暂行处理接受，只拿到一半分。

shots.narration_en: And none of the five sheets contains a formula. The amounts are typed-in values, so the calculation chain can't be traced to the source fields.
shots.caption_zh: 此外，五张表里一个公式都没有。金额都是直接写入的数值，计算链无法追溯到来源字段。

shots.narration_en: Of 20 positive criteria, 3 are met, 6 partly met, and 11 not met. No penalties were triggered, and both red lines held.
shots.caption_zh: 20 个正向评分项中，3 项满足、6 项部分满足、11 项未满足；5 个扣分项均未触发，两条红线都守住了。

shots.narration_en: The recorded reward is 0.333: 57.25 of 172 weighted points. One pilot run's rubric score, not accuracy, and not a ranking.
shots.caption_zh: 记录的奖励值为 0.333，即加权得分 57.25 / 172。这是一次试跑的评分结果，不是准确率，也不是排名。

shots.narration_en: A professional task, an agent run, and an independent check. Explore more on the InferenceNet Challenge site.
shots.caption_zh: 专业任务、Agent 运行、独立检验。更多内容见 InferenceNet Challenge 网站。

request_metadata.note: Derived metadata only; original transcript is excluded.

editable_source.offline: Uses the 34 supplied narration MP3 clips and voice.json; do not run voice.py for this rebuild.

boundaries: Editorial replay of an existing recorded pilot run; no new agent run, no re-scoring.
Request numbers are the 28 assistant message ids of the Claude Code session log; tool steps are run-export indexes.
Claude Code and Bash run inside the task's Docker container; the model is reached through an API.
The rubric and tests are absent during the agent run; Harbor copies tests into the same container afterwards.
Judge sessions are separate per criterion; scores never feed back into the recorded agent run.
